summary_fi: Komentokeskuksen koodi on kunnossa ja valmis Verceliin, mutta itse nettiosoitteen toimivuuden pitää vielä tarkistaa komentaja Vercelin esikatselulinkiltä.

checks.check: The command center is reachable at the project's Vercel deployment URL (no local server needed) and shows the robot model and the manual on page 1.

The deployment is public and serves the whole repository as static files (Framework Preset: Other) plus api/inspections.js — verify no secret, credential or personal data ever exists in the repo before this brick is approved
api/inspections.js reads only docs/inspections/*.json filenames matching the brick-id pattern, never a path taken from the request
